title: BPP hello request (DESIGN.md §14.6 negotiation family): argument-free liveness and version probe
description: Available on each advertised surface to a bounded pre-auth client or any actor valid for that surface; closure is endpoint/version only, fenced by parser and rate limits (§14.7). hello is a read: meta is absent by construction (closed schema). DESIGN.md defines no request arguments for hello; this schema pins the envelope only.
